subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
12. Ajay Sharma undertook a retrenchment strategy to save his company when
the sales of his company declined, and his company was called outdated. The
action plan undertaken to implement it was
(i)  Assessing the current problem
(ii)  Providing innovative transport service
(iii)  Developing an action plan with specific goals
(iv)  Restructuring organizational hierarchy

Which of the above actions does not pertain to the strategy undertaken by
Ajay Sharma?
(A)  (ii) and (iv)
(B)  (iii) and (iv)
(C)  (i), (iii) and (iv)
(D)  Only (iii)
(2 Marks)
